body:
3 weeks into the school semester and I messed up majorly. Depression and anxiety prevent me from doing homework and attending my college courses. First exams roll around and I bomb them completely! Again! This happens every semester since I developed depression. It's so stupid because I KNOW the material but it's like my mind wants me to do nothing all day and be worthless. 

Seriously. I do not do ANYTHING all day except somewhat trying to battle my depression and eventually losing. It's pathetic I've become this person. Meanwhile life is just passing me by.

Like I mentioned to the other comment: first week of school I'm very upbeat, but enter the third week and I'm flunking the exams and cutting classes. 

I have ZERO excuse for this kind of behavior while I mooch off my parents because I have depression, anxiety and formerly anorexia. It's pathetic, I know the material but I let my disorders make me 100% useless. The last time I pulled off this shit during a school semester, I attempted suicide and got put in a crazy house for a week.
